section.title: PIM Synchronization
section.p: The personal information manager PIM synchronization converts contact information stored in LDIF or VCARD formats. The algorithm transparently identifies the contact language and handle localization and protocol specifities. Command line options exist to specify the default language and country of the address book owner. The application is used in the pmMDA group to convert Mozilla Thunderbird LDIF contacts into VCARD contacts and store them on an Apple Nano iPod . The used business model support journal entries to trace activities. The complete application model was generated with pmMDA . Please consult the JavaDoc documentation for a detailed description of the application and the provided command line options.

This small project shows the power of the pmMDA pragmatic approach. The provided user interface and the consistent usage of Apache libraries minimize the amount of hand written code. The example is a showcase of the capabilities of the explorer framework but avoid the complexities of the pmMDA application.
